Method of Attack: Malicious VBScript camouflaged as popular Hollywood movies
Delivery via ZIP files posing as movie downloads
Downloading additional malicious payloads using living-off-the-land binaries (LOLbins) such as BITSAdmin
AutoIT script decoding second-stage DLL into memory
Reflective loading of third DLL injecting coin-mining code into notepad.exe process via process hollowing
Impacted Systems: Enterprises from Spain and some South American countries
Attack Vector: ZIP files posing as movie downloads
Indicators of Compromise: File names: John_Wick_3_Parabellum, contagio-1080p, Punales_por_la_espalda_BluRay_1080p, La_hija_de_un_ladron, Lo-dejo-cuando-quiera
